Title: Fix PrepareToInstall prereq check silently skipped
Description: In SplitBrainAI.iss PrepareToInstall, the function references {tmp}\installer-scripts\Test-Prerequisites.ps1. But PrepareToInstall runs before [Files] are copied to {app}. Scripts are never staged to {tmp}. The Exec call silently fails and prereq checks are entirely bypassed. Fix: inline a lightweight prereq check using direct PowerShell commands (dotnet --version, free disk check) rather than calling an external script.
